sql: SELECT n.value FROM sub s JOIN dnum n ON n.adsh = s.adsh WHERE s.name = 'SOUTHERN CO' AND s.form = '10-Q' AND s.period = 20260630 AND n.tag = 'NetIncomeLoss' AND n.ddate = 20260630 AND n.qtrs = 1 AND n.uom = 'USD' AND n.ndims = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim d WHERE d.fact_id = n.fact_id AND d.axis = 'LegalEntity' AND d.member = 'GeorgiaPower')
